description.en: A giant beaver reconstruction with grooved incisors, a deep body and a conservative narrow tapered tail. It combines separate fossil evidence; tail form and other soft tissues remain interpretations, not a modern paddle-tail copy.
description.zh: 巨型河狸的完整复原，具有纵沟门齿、厚躯与保守的狭长渐细尾。综合不同化石证据，尾形及其他软组织仍属解释，不照搬现代扁桨尾。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole giant beaver: broad rodent skull, paired large longitudinally grooved incisors, deep-bodied aquatic outline with conservative narrow tapered tail.

scientific_limits.en: Composite reconstruction, not one complete fossil. Minnesota skeleton photograph is juvenile with no scale/catalog visible; do not assign adult maximum to that individual. Wood1914 Pittsfield skull dimensions differ from NYSM VP47 dorsal skull photograph. Bell Museum maximum7ft is species-level approximate total, not measured headbody. Narrow tail is probable museum interpretation, webbing/fur/ears/color inferred. No modern broad paddle or dam-building scene.
scientific_limits.zh: 综合活体复原而非同一完整标本。明尼苏达骨架照片是幼体，无尺/编号，不套成年最大尺寸。1914 Pittsfield颅测量与NYSM VP47颅图不同件。博物馆7英尺是属种大致最长估值非实测头体长；细长尾为可能解释，蹼毛耳色推定，无现代扁桨尾或筑坝场景。

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Mammalia, Rodentia, Castoridae; not extant Castor.

scale.status: Skull dimensions Wood1914 reported; body/tail/shoulder/width are artistic estimates, total2.05m under museum approximate7ft maximum, no specimen-level total claim.

diagnostic_targets: Broad low rodent head and broad zygomatic silhouette, not narrow doglike muzzle.
Paired curved upper and lower incisors visible at slightly open mouth; longitudinal fluting modeled cheaply, not smooth modern chisel blades.
Deep barrel torso, short forelimbs and larger hindfeet; full four-limbed animal.
Narrow long tapering tail, not broad flat Castor paddle; soft tail crosssection inferred.
Conservative inferred aquatic mammal flesh/fur and modest webbing, no haircards or water scene.
